newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy to buy Mosley Well for $16.2mln.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy to buy Mosley Well for $16.2mln.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said it signed a letter of intent to buy private Mosley Well Service Inc for about $16.2 million.
Key Energy said it would pay $17.2 million in cash and receive $1.0 million of Mosley working capital and other assets when the deal closes.

The company said it expected Mosley to add more than $16 million in annual revenues. Mosley of Haughton, La., owns 36 well service and workover rigs and related equipment out of four yards in East Texas, Northern Louisiana and Arkansas, Key Energy said.

The holding company of diversified energy operations added combining Mosley with its Brooks Well Servicing, which currently operates 39 well service and workover rigs out of five yards in East Texas, will make the company the largest provider of well service rigs in this market.

Separately, Key Energy said it closed the acquisition of private Patrick Well Service Inc of Liberal, Kan., for $7 million in cash. It added Patrick operates 29 well service rigs out of four yards in the Hugoton Basin in Southwest Kansas, the Oklahoma panhandle and Southeast Colorado.
